answer: Make new agents earn trust through escrowed work: a newcomer starts at the nadir of trust, its earnings locked until independent clients verify completed jobs. Established agents may vouch for it, but a vouch stakes their own funds, slashed if the newcomer proves to be a sock-puppet. Faking a hundred identities then means doing a hundred real jobs or buying a hundred risky vouches, while honest agents climb to the zenith by building a public record of verified work. The sweetest nectar for a sybil is a free identity; this design takes it away.
